messages:
cecilia (Billing): FYI Citadel Dynamics INV-2026-1404 (USD 7,300) is 37 days overdue. Multiple ACH attempts returned R09. AP says they're migrating banks and asked for temporary split-pay while they finish the migration. They requested no service interruption.
omar (Collections): For $7.3k we need Revenue Ops/Finance approval for term changes. Usual plays: 1) 30% today + staged net30/net60, or 2) 60% now if they can wire, remainder net30. Require signed payment plan and PO.
jess (FinOps): Finance can approve a one-off split if we get: proof of funds for initial payment, signed agreement, and GL tagging. We can waive up to $150 in late fees without exec, more needs CFO sign-off. Also need to record concession in AR notes.
tara (Account Exec): I'm on the customer thread; treasury says they'll push 30% today if we accept a 3-pay plan (30/35/35) and won't tolerate suspension. They'll provide PO and a bank confirmation.
cecilia (Billing): Proposed plan: accept 30% via wire today, apply provisional credit for late fees up to $150, set dunning pause for 14 days, collect 35% at 30d and 35% at 60d. Require signed plan and PO by EOD.
omar (Collections): OK but add clause: if initial payment doesn't clear within 48h, the pause is revoked and dunning resumes. Also include auto-retry schedule for failed ACHs.
legal-bot: Quick note: standard payment plan template requires customer signature and a default clause allowing immediate suspension on subsequent failure. Please confirm if we want the standard template.
jess (FinOps): Approve provisional fee waiver up to $150 contingent on proof of wire for the initial 30% and signed plan. Tag GL 4310-CONCESSION and include in weekly AR memo for leadership.
cecilia (Billing): I'll send payment link and upload the plan. Tara, please push the customer for bank confirmation and PO. Omar, can you draft the plan with the suspension clause?
omar (Collections): Drafting now. Will attach in 20m and set follow-ups for 48h.
tara (Account Exec): Customer replied: treasury confirmed wire intent and will send proof of transfer + PO within 6 hours. They accepted the 30/35/35 split and signed the agreement digitally when I sent a portal link.
cecilia (Billing): Got the signed plan and a screenshot of wire instruction. I'll mark invoice as "pending_initial_wire" and set follow-up.
jess (FinOps): Once wire clears Finance will post receipt and apply GL entries. If wire fails, reverse provisional credit and resume collections. I'll note this in the FP&A handoff.
cecilia (Billing): billing-bot: invoice INV-2026-1404 status set to "pending_initial_wire" by cecilia (Billing) at 2312345720.
tara (Account Exec): I'll confirm with customer when the wire posts. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
